messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing the co-marketing playbook for CloudX marketplace listing + joint webinar. Proposed timeline below, pls chime in. @oliver @sasha :calendar:
oliver: Monday works for me. I can help with the demo deck and the micro-benchmarks.
sasha: I'm OOO Tue-Wed morning, Wed afternoon is ok for rehearsal.
raj: I can own funnel mapping and lead routing rules (will wire to SFDC + Hub).
maya: Draft checklist: 1) marketplace listing copy + 3 screenshots, 2) 30-min webinar + demo, 3) mini-benchmark blog (perf vs baseline), 4) lead routing + qualification flow, 5) announcement post + partner co-mail.
sasha: small ask — add CTA variants: "Start free trial" vs "Request demo". Trial seems to convert better on marketplace historically.
oliver: agree on A/Bing CTAs. For enterprise leads we'll surface demo option.
raj: Routing rules (draft): capture utm_source=cloudx, tag partner:CloudX, set lead.owner = SmartCampaign 'CloudX-2026' queue. If company_size > 500 then owner_team=AE else SDR. I'll add automation.
maya: sample rule snippet for staging ops:
```
if (utm_source == 'cloudx') {
  lead.tags.push('partner:cloudx');
  assignQueue('CloudX-2026');
}
```
amanda-bot: Reminder — campaign kickoff form due in 48h: https://redwood.app/forms/marketing :bell:
sasha: Marketing ops — can we do enrichment? need separation for SDR vs AE segments and ICP scoring.
raj: yep — I'll add enrichment job to run on inbound, append firmagraphic fields, then run segment assignment. Will post the automation JSON to the doc.
oliver: about the benchmark blog: think we should keep it lightweight — 3 charts (latency, cost-per-token, tail-percentiles) + one paragraph framing the takeaway. That helps the marketplace listing.
maya: good — timeline: content drafts due Fri EOD, oliver to share benchmark results by Thu EOD, rehearsal next Wed 10:30am, publish + webinar two weeks after rehearsal.
sasha: I'll draft messaging for announcement and the webinar description. oliver — can you shoot screenshots of the demo flow by Thu?
oliver: yep, will capture tonight and upload to the shared folder. ping me if it doesn't show up. :camera_flash:
maya: perfect. I'll update the master playbook doc and tag owners: https://redwood.app/docs/marketing/cloudx-playbook. Thanks all — small sprint but high impact :rocket:
